# fortiappseccloud_waf_request_limits

Configures request limits for one FortiAppSec Cloud application using the static app endpoint `/waf/apps/{ep_id}/request_limits`. Set `template = false` and provide `configs` to manage settings directly. Set `template = true` and omit `configs` to inherit this module from the application's attached WAF template.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_request_limits` resource for an application endpoint. Template-level settings are managed by `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_request_limits`.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_request_limits" "example" {
  ep_id    = fortiappseccloud_waf_app.example.ep_id
  template = false

  configs {
    status              = true
    body_param_len      = 8192
    cookie_num          = 128
    http_req_len        = 2048
    malformed_url_check = true
    range_num           = 5
    http_header_action  = "alert_deny"

    # Omit this ownership wrapper to preserve the complete remote allow_methods
    # array. Keep the wrapper but remove every item block to explicitly send [].
    allow_methods {
      item { method = "get" }
      item { method = "post" }
      item { method = "head" }
    }
  }
}
```

## Import

Import using the application `ep_id`:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_request_limits.example application-endpoint-id
```

The first read after import hydrates all ownership wrappers when `template = false`.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
